# @arki/env

> Type-safe environment variables: `defineEnv()` validates lazily with any Standard Schema, `secret()` keeps values out of logs, and `@arki/env/dot` validates at Dot boot. It is not a config-file loader.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/env`: The `contracts` namespace of ready-made variable shapes, for `defineEnv()`. `contracts`.
- `@arki/env/core`: `defineEnv()` plus `secret()`, `reveal()` and `Redacted` for typed, lazily validated environments. `Redacted`, `contracts`, `defineEnv`, `reveal`, `secret`.
- `@arki/env/contracts`: Ready-made Zod contracts for ports, URLs, lists, JSON and other common variable shapes. `commonContracts`, `contracts`, `parseContracts`, `urlContracts`.
- `@arki/env/dot`: DOT adapter for @arki/env. `ENV_PLUGIN_ERROR_CODES`, `env`; types `EnvDotOptions`, `EnvServices`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Rules that bite
- Validation runs everywhere. Only `SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=1` (exactly `1`) skips it.
- Read a secret with `reveal(env.KEY)`. It prints as `[redacted]` otherwise.
- Pass `runtimeEnv` on engines with no `process`.
- Schemas validate synchronously; the first read validates, not the import.
